kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: 'Taiwan Travelogue' rethinks history, colonialism, and identity
wire.summary: The author and translator of Taiwan Travelogue, the winner of the 2026 International Booker Prize, discuss identity and history amid the debate over Taiwan's colonial ties to Japan and escalating geopolitical pressure from China.

wire.title: 'Odyssey' translator Emily Wilson says Nolan shouldn't have written the movie himself
wire.summary: The renowned classics scholar caused a stir when her critical review of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey went viral. Wilson explains her reaction to the film and why she's translating the poem again.

wire.title: Greetings from an isolated region in northern Pakistan's Hindu Kush mountains
wire.summary: Chitral borders Afghanistan and isn't easy to reach. Breathtaking views abound in this remote mountainous region — as do rockslides and avalanches.

wire.title: U.S. and Iran resume attacks. And, Fauci to face Senate questions on COVID pandemic
wire.summary: The U.S. and Iran have resumed fighting after Iran attacked U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday. And, a Senate committee will question Anthony Fauci about the COVID-19 pandemic.

wire.title: New York school pauses plan to deploy humanlike AI robot teacher after backlash
wire.summary: A school district in upstate New York is pausing plans to deploy an AI-powered, humanoid robot in the classroom after state education officials, teachers and local residents raised concerns.

wire.title: Iran resumes missile attacks as U.S. and Saudis strike Tehran-backed militias in Iraq
wire.summary: The flare-up on multiple fronts raised the risk of a return to all-out war, underscoring the difficulty of winding down a five-month conflict that has jolted the world economy.

wire.title: 'Machines are collaborators' at this new museum of AI art
wire.summary: "What is beyond reality?" asks artist Refik Anadol. His latest projects include Dataland, an immersive AI art museum in Los Angeles, and an installation at the Smithsonian in Washington, D.C.

wire.title: As extreme heat grips the South and West, here's how to stay safe
wire.summary: Experts say immersion in cold water before an ambulance arrives can greatly increase the chances of heat stroke survival and reduce the risk of long-term complications.

wire.title: The Federal Reserve faces a critical decision on interest rates
wire.summary: Policymakers at the Federal Reserve are meeting to discuss interest rates Wednesday. They're expected to hold rates steady, but there's a chance they could raise rates to combat stubborn inflation.

wire.title: More Americans are going bankrupt. What does that mean?
wire.summary: The bankruptcy rate has risen about 48% between 2022 and 2025, although it's still below pre-pandemic levels.

wire.title: Two firefighters die in Crete as wildfires threaten parts of southern Europe
wire.summary: Gale-force winds have whipped up the flames prompting the evacuation of several villages on the island, as parts of the continent also continue to tackle fires.

wire.title: France fire crews face searing heat in battle to contain flames
wire.summary: Firefighters are battling flare-ups in 40C heat, as some locals have refused to heed evacuations in the Gironde region.

wire.title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
wire.summary: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say

wire.title: Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq
wire.summary: US Central Command says proxy groups launched attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.

wire.title: Anthony Fauci refuses to answer questions during US Senate hearing discussing Covid origins
wire.summary: The former top US health official said he feared Republicans could try to trip him up and use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

wire.title: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct
wire.summary: The actor and musician faces allegations from 10 women in total who say he mistreated them as teenagers.
